title: JCB Succession Underway After Making Founder’s Grandson Co-Chair
summary: J.C. Bamford Excavators Ltd. said that George Bamford will become joint chairman of the company alongside his father, marking the first change at the top of one of the UK’s biggest private companies in more than 50 years.

title: Oil Gains, Stock Futures Dip as Trump Rebuffs Iran: Markets Wrap
summary: Oil advanced and US equity-index futures slipped after President Donald Trump rejected Iran’s latest proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, reigniting Middle East tensions that have roiled bond markets.

title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Sept. 28
summary: Oil rose as Iran stuck to a seven-day proposal for reopening the crucial Strait of Hormuz rejected by US President Donald Trump, threatening further delays in the reopening of the crucial waterway.

title: Trump Says He’s ‘Very Seriously’ Looking at Diesel Export Ban
summary: President Donald Trump said he is still looking “very seriously” at implementing a US ban on diesel exports to combat high prices, even as others in his administration continue to focus on other possible steps.
